_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil conditions (flat 30d, calm VIX, mixed funding) keep phase anchored in Hope; downside flags exist but range break is unconfirmed.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/coil; narrative supplies inflow pressure without a phase/direction call; consensus holds phase and stays non-directional until break.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound with 30d momentum near 50 and fear/greed holding in the 60s without a funding spike
next_move.invalidated_if: Range breaks lower with CVD suppressed and fear/greed under 55, or momentum reheats above ~70 with funding firmly positive
